evidence.note: The upstream kernel accumulates each coefficient across Q_size RNS planes, takes a data-dependent sum_gamma > gamma/2 branch, and contains no synchronization.
The BFV decryptor launches decryption_kernel with 256 threads and grid.x=n>>8; the adapter extracts one guarded coefficient tile from that fixed geometry.

The adapter preserves the RNS access and branch logic, flattens both 24-byte by-value Modulus64 values into six uint64_t fields, and bounds one 32..256 coefficient tile. VConfig responsiveness: 固定几何，仅可作阴性对照.
